**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The IP package in §14 (read with §§1.3, 1.4, 1.8, 13.2 and 15.1) already delivers our preferred position:

- **Deliverables (§14.2):** Customer owns each Deliverable on creation, with a present assignment from Vendor, equivalent assignments from Vendor personnel, and further-assurance cooperation.
- **Customer Data and our IP (§14.1):** Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right to provide, secure, support and improve the Services *for Customer*. §15.1 blocks sale, advertising use, commingling and model training without our written consent.
- **Vendor IP (§14.3 / §1.8 / §13.2):** Vendor keeps only Vendor Technology (which expressly excludes Customer Data and our pre-existing IP), and anything embedded in a Deliverable is covered by the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works, extending to Affiliates and contractors.
- **No joint ownership (§14.4):** Joint IP requires a separate signed instrument; feedback use is limited and our own feedback rights are preserved.

Acceptable residual points, not flagged: ownership vesting is "subject to payment of the applicable Fees" (matching §10.2's delivery-on-payment mechanic), "Deliverable" is limited to work product an Order Form identifies (manageable at Order Form drafting), and the Customer Data definition carves out unlinkable anonymized telemetry.
